description: Measured existing source GIFs, not repaired or generated animation. Source SHA-256 identifies exact inputs; artwork is not included by this change.

takes.scope: Review one outfit per invocation. Scores prioritize inspection, not artistic acceptance. No pose interpolation, retiming, rearrangement or automatic repair. Static opaque backgrounds can dilute full-frame scores: use an authored focus rectangle. Rates are pixel change per combined identical visible hold, not physical velocity. The baseline excludes unchanged adjacent edges and the loop seam. Loop seam is hypothetical for play-once sources.
